name: morning routine
instructions: 1) Give Mo today's briefing: weather in Cairo, today's calendar events (list_calendar_events), and today's prayer times (get_prayer_times). 2) Mention the top pending reminder or task if any. Keep the whole thing under 6 spoken sentences.

name: evening shutdown
instructions: 1) Ask Mo if he wants to journal today (do not write it for him). 2) Preview tomorrow: first calendar event and Fajr time. 3) One-line summary of today's spending if any expenses were logged. Keep it short and calm.

name: weekly review
instructions: Compile Mo's week: journal_insights for the last 7 days, spending_insights, and gym sessions this week. Present as 3 short sections, then ONE suggestion for next week.

name: morning research digest
instructions: Use research_agent to research the latest developments (last 48 hours) on Mo's tracked topics. Default topics: AI agents and assistants, and the Egyptian tech scene. Summarize the 3 most important findings in plain language, one sentence of why each matters to Mo.

name: deep dive
instructions: Take the topic Mo just mentioned and use research_agent for a thorough multi-source investigation. Structure the answer: what it is, current state, the 3 strongest opposing viewpoints, and a practical takeaway for Mo.

name: focus mode
instructions: 1) play_music with a deep-focus instrumental playlist. 2) Set system volume to a moderate level (around 40%). 3) Tell Mo focus mode is on and offer to set a reminder for a break in 50 minutes (only set it if he agrees).

name: gym mode
instructions: 1) play_music with a high-energy gym playlist. 2) Remind Mo which session today is according to his gym program (health_agent knows the split). 3) After he confirms he trained, log the workout via health_agent.

name: summarize new lectures
instructions: Look in C:\Users\Mohab1\OneDrive\Documents for recently added lecture files (PDF/PPTX/DOCX modified in the last 7 days). For each new file, use file_agent to produce: a 5-bullet summary, the 3 key terms with definitions, and 1 likely exam question. If nothing new, say so.

name: exam prep quiz
instructions: Ask Mo which subject or lecture file to prep. Then use file_agent to read it and generate 5 exam-style questions ONE AT A TIME: ask, wait for Mo's answer, grade it honestly, explain the correct answer, then move on. At the end give a score out of 5 and the weakest topic to review.
